issues.failure_explanation: The main-text variance formula uses the coefficient $\rho\lambda^{1-\alpha}$ for the matrix $\rho$, but the correct coefficient is $\rho\lambda/(1-\alpha)$. This follows from $\mathbb{V}[L(t)] = \operatorname{Var}(\eta G(t)) + \mathbb{E}[G(t)]\rho = \delta\Gamma(2-\alpha)/\lambda^{2-\alpha}(\eta\eta^{\top} + \rho\lambda/(1-\alpha))$. The appendix table gives the correct expression, so the main-text displayed equation is false for $\alpha\neq 0$.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace $\rho\lambda^{1-\alpha}$ by $\rho\lambda/(1-\alpha)$ in the main-text variance formula.
issues.overall_effect: The stated variance of the NTS process is incorrect and contradicts the appendix table. Readers using the main-text formula would compute wrong variances and standard deviations for NIG-type parameter sets.
issues.title: Incorrect variance formula for the Normal Tempered Stable process
issues.why_classification: The error is a single local formula correction; the appendix already contains the correct expression, and no other argument or guarantee depends on the erroneous version.

issues.failure_explanation: For the VG0 parameters, $\lambda=1$, $\eta=(-0.1,-0.2)$, and $\rho=\begin{pmatrix}0.09&0.06\\0.06&0.16\end{pmatrix}$. Then $\|\eta\|_\rho^2=\eta^\top\rho^{-1}\eta\approx 0.2593$, so $\|\eta\|_\rho\approx 0.5092$. The paper's formula gives $B_\ell=\sqrt{0.2593+2}-0.5092\approx 0.9939$, which is less than the required $B_\ell>2$. Thus the VG0 parameter set lies outside the paper's stated model assumptions.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Either replace VG0 with a parameter set satisfying $B_\ell>2$, or explicitly qualify that VG0 is outside the assumed regime and adjust the scope claims accordingly.
issues.overall_effect: The VG0 numerical experiments, including its entries in Table 3 and its convergence curve, are not covered by the stated model framework. The claim that the numerical experiments validate the method under the paper's assumptions is therefore weakened for this parameter set.
issues.title: VG0 parameter set violates the assumed exponential decay condition
